name: wait
description: What a poll loop waits on, one type on every system and for every component that works while the loop runs: descriptors (sockets on Windows) and a timeout; block and ready to wait on it with poll or WSAPoll; and a pool of at most 32 threads with a cancellable FIFO line, and the close-on-exec pipe (Linux and macOS) or non-inherited loopback socket pair (Windows) that says the work is done.
